assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse liver (BGISEQ-500), plus proteomics/lactylome (PXD057080) and metabolomics (MTBLS11477) not analysed here
sample_inclusion: adult male C57BL/6J mice, liver; transcriptomics n=3 per group (S2.1.p1)
primary_estimand: effect of 6 weeks of moderate-intensity treadmill exercise vs sedentary control on liver gene expression, sampled within 24 h after the last bout (S2.1.p1)
planned_contrasts: Experimental (EX) vs Control (SED), liver (S8.1.p1; paper: 2034 DEGs, 1456 up / 578 down)
paper_method: limma v3.46.0 on log2(TPM+1), ~ group (S3.p1, S7.1.p1, TAB1)

paper_threshold.note: paper: raw p < 0.05 & (FC > 1.2 or FC < 0.83); the down cutoff 0.83 is log2 = -0.2688167, slightly stricter than 1/1.2

paper_results: 2034 DEGs (1456 up, 578 down); 82 intersection genes with Hallmark hypoxia/glycolysis/fatty-acid sets; hub genes Aldoa, Acsl1, Hadhb up in EX at mRNA level (S8.1.p1, S8.3.p1); Fasn up (S9.p3)
